Repentance 2026 - Sets 1-11 channel
Paste-ready YouTube descriptions. ASCII hyphens. Same topic lines as the first 20s-series channel.

Calendar (this is the wrap, not 33 leftover-6 days): each day is 20 topics in one stream of 11 sets x 3 rounds x 666.
Day 33 = Round 1 topics 641-660.
Day 34 = Round 1 topics 661-666 + Round 2 topics 001-014.
Day 67 = Round 2 topics 655-666 (12) + Round 3 topics 001-008 (8).
(Chunking by 20 after the 6+14 wrap is 12+8 at the Round 2/3 join, not 11+9.)
Day 100 = last 18 of Set 1 Round 3 + first 2 of Set 2 Round 1.
Last channel day 1099 has 18 topics (21961-21978).
YouTube descriptions cap at 5000 characters; each day block is one video.
